"''No, but he can buy them a little more time.|Col Takbright and Wenton Chan, moments before Surrel's demise|}} '''Ralo Surrel''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. A member of [[Red Squadron]], he held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]] and often flew as [[wingmate]] to [[Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis]]. Surrel participated in the battles of [[Battle of Scarif|Scarif]] and [[Battle of Yavin|Yavin]], where he met his death. ==Biography== Prior to his service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]], Ralo Surrel performed as a stunt [[pilot]], flying antique craft for the amusement of [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] audiences. By [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|RO}} he had joined the Rebel Alliance as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in [[Red Squadron]], commissioned as a [[major]] and stationed at [[Great Temple|Base One]] on the [[Yavin 4|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]]. Along with [[Theron Nett]], Surrel often flew as [[wingmate]] to [[Commander]] [[Garven Dreis]], who served as [[Red Leader]]. At one point, Surrel and Dreis were scheduled to fly Shift Cycle 1 of an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] patrol mission from Yavin to the [[Gordian Reach|Gordian]] Trace Relays, where they would perform a flyby of surrounding space, verify all-clear visuals and sensors, and perform close uplink of passive relay recordings.''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' ===Battle of Scarif=== [[File:RebelPilots-BaseSeries4.png|thumb|right|250px|Ralo Surrel between fellow pilots Wion Dillems and Harb Binli]] Surrel, along with the rest of Red Squadron, participated in the [[Battle of Scarif]]. As the [[Rogue One]] team attempted to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the [[Death Star]] [[superweapon]] from the [[Imperial Center of Military Research]] on the [[planet]], Red Squadron began dogfighting the Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] [[garrison]]. Flying as [[Red Eleven]], he again flew as wing to Red Leader. Surrel survived the engagement, which saw the successful transmission of the plans to a [[Tantive IV|corvette]] under [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. ===Battle of Yavin and death=== {{Quote|Red Eleven standing by.|Ralo Surrel checking in at Yavin|{{Film|IV}}}} [[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|left|250px|Surrel led Red Squadron's second flight at Yavin]] The plans were eventually brought to the rebel base on Yavin, where [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] assembled the rebel pilots. The Death Star was rapidly approaching the rebel base, but Dodonna explained that the pilots would seek to [[Battle of Yavin|exploit]] a design flaw placed in the [[battle station]]: a [[thermal exhaust port]] which would allow [[proton torpedo]]es to destroy the station's [[Reactor|main reactor]]. After the briefing, Surrel entered the Red Squadron ready room with Dreis and [[Zal Dinnes]]. For the squadron's final flight plan, he was substituted as Dreis' port wingman for [[Puck Naeco]] ([[Red Twelve]]); instead Surrel was given command of [[second flight]], comprised of wingmates [[John D. Branon]] ([[Red Four]]) and [[Cadet|Cdt.]] [[Harb Binli]] ([[Red Seven]]). As they approached the Death Star, Dreis directed Red Squadron to cut across the battle station's axis and draw Imperial [[turbolaser]] fire, as [[Gold Squadron]]'s [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wings]] made their attack run on the [[meridian trench]]. Shortly thereafter, Imperial TIEs were scrambled, whittling away Red Squadron; Surrel's wingmate Branon was the first to succumb to the enemy fighters, and Binli soon followed. As [[Lieutenant|Lt.]] [[Nozzo Naytaan]] ([[Red Nine]]) was shot down, Surrel was left alone amidst a swarm of TIEs. Though back in the Massassi control room, grounded pilot [[Col Takbright]] urged command to pull Surrel out, to no avail. Red Eleven died sacrificing himself, buying time for [[Luke Skywalker]] ([[Red Five]]) to complete his final run on the exhaust port. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|To Dreis, Branon, Porkins, Rue, Dinnes, Naytaan, Nett, Surrel, Naeco,…|Skywalker, honoring Surrel and Red Squadron's actions|[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]]}} With the help of [[the Force]], Skywalker's proton torpedoes found their mark, and the station was destroyed, allowing the rebellion to survive. In [[1 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Book X: Mutiny at Mon Cala]]'' to [[1 ABY]]. Skywalker and fellow rebels [[Han Solo]], [[Wedge Antilles]], [[Zev Senesca]], [[Derek Klivian]], and [[Chewbacca]] raised a toast at [[Mess Hall IV]] in the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] to honor the deceased members of Red Squadron, including Surrel. ==Personality and traits== [[File:RaloSurrelHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Surrel's flight helmet]] Audiences in the Outer Rim considered Ralo Surrel a dashing stunt [[pilot]], flying rickety antiques for their amusement. ==Equipment== As a Rebel Alliance X-wing starfighter pilot, Ralo Surrel wore an [[Color|orange]] [[flight suit]], with a white [[flak vest]], a gray [[flight harness]], a [[Diagnostech life support unit]], dark gray [[glove]]s and black [[boot]]s. His [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was white, with a red and gray checkered pattern above the visor, a red and gray stripe along the central ridge, and a black symbol on each side.''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' ==Behind the scenes== Ralo Surrel is played by actor [[Russell Balogh]]{{Instagram|username=russellbalogh|url=p/BLqJN09AX_N|name=Balogh, Russell|quote=A new image of me as Major Ralo Surrel (Red Eleven) and 2 fellow rebel pilots from 'Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'|archivefile=File:Instagram-Russell-Balogh.png}} in the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. Prior to the release of the film on [[December 16]], [[2016]], the character was first shown in the initial teaser trailer for the film, released on [[April 7]] of that year.{{SW|url=news/watch-the-rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-teaser-trailer|text=Watch the ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer!}} The [[2017]] short story "[[Duty Roster]]," written by [[Jason Fry]] as part of ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]''—a collection of short stories by various authors—established that Surrel was the pilot who flew as Red Eleven in the Battle of Yavin, thus [[Retroactive continuity|retconning]] him into the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and its [[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|junior novelization]].[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] Surrel takes the spot that, in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, was held by [[Wenton Chan/Legends|Wenton Chan]].{{CSWECite|I|119|Chan, Wenton}} In canon, [[Wenton Chan|Chan]] was established by "Duty Roster" as being grounded during the battle; however, in the story he does mention Surrel's performance during the battle. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ralo Surrel}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} {{Ret}} {{Voice}} *[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] {{Voice}} {{Ret}} *{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} *[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]] {{Mo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Ralo Surrel}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Ralo Surrel|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644223}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} {{C|Starfighter only}} *''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} *''[[Star Wars 100 Objects]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Ralo Surrel#kanon |fr=Ralo Surrel |ka=რალო სარელი |nl=Ralo Surrel |pl=Ralo Surrel }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Surrel, Ralo}} [[Category:Alliance Starfighter Corps officers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Majors]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Red Squadron personnel]]
